messages:
Sam T.: FYI we received a DSAR delete confirmation request (acct-5544) but the deletion receipt we normally attach is missing the audit log snippet. It looks like the erasure job ran but theres no `storage.objects.delete` entry in Cloud Audit Logs for that timeframe :confused:
Lina V.: Wait, missing audit log? Are we sure the job actually called the API? Could have retried to a different project or used a different SA
Sam T.: I pulled the erasure job trace: job-id eraser-2026-03-20-xx, runtime shows success. Trace includes calls to embeddings-service but the audit export shows a gap from 03:15-03:20 where erasure should have logged
Omar N.: Quick check: IAM policy changes yesterday rolled out `roles/logging.logWriter` removal for service-account erasure@redwood. That might prevent write of structured logs or export. Im looking at the IAM audit: `projects/redwood-prod: setIamPolicy` changed bindings at 2026-03-19T22:40Z
Priya R.: If the SA lost permission to write logs, Cloud Audit Logs would still have admin activity, but not the application-level structured entries. Check AuditConfig and the logs export sink. Could the sink have failed at that window?
Sam T.: I checked sinks: sink `audit-exports` was healthy. But AuditBot shows an IAM change event: AuditBot: `iam:policy_update user=ops-deploy reason=rbac_cleanup change=removed role:roles/logging.logWriter from serviceAccount:erasure@redwood`
Lina V.: That explains it. The erasure job likely executed but couldn't emit the structured audit entry we include in receipts. For DSARs we need an auditable chain. Legal will need to know.
Anya (Legal): This is serious. Under GDPR we need to provide proof of deletion or a retention exception. If the deletion occurred but we lack logs, we must document the actions taken to reconstruct evidence and whether data remains retrievable. Please gather all alternate evidence: storage object metadata, job traces, S3/GCS object versions, KMS key access history
Omar N.: KMS integration note: keystore access events are going to Cloud KMS audit logs in a separate project. I can pull the `cryptoKeyVersions.access` events but if the SA couldn't write app logs, KMS logs should still show decrypt calls if those happened.
Priya R.: Steps I propose now: 1) Pause the erasure queue for ephemeral/backfill tenants to prevent further runs until RBAC is fixed 2) Re-grant minimal logging role to erasure SA 3) Re-run the erasure job in a dry-run mode that emits receipts to internal storage (not public) 4) Collect KMS crypto access logs and storage object metadata 5) Open retention-exception ticket if we can't fully reconstruct receipts
Sam T.: Agreed. I've paused the queue: `./scripts/erasure pause --queue ephemeral` and pinned the change in ops-console.
Omar N.: Re-granting now: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:erasure@redwood --role=roles/logging.logWriter` 
AuditBot: IAM change recorded: `policy_update actor=ops-deploy role_added=roles/logging.logWriter member=serviceAccount:erasure@redwood`
Sam T.: Thanks. Once role is back, can we replay the job and generate a canonical receipt that includes a new audit snippet and also reference original run-id? We need to avoid double-delete; receipts should show we only touched metadata for proof
Lina V.: We should not actually delete objects again. The replay should be a read-only proof generation: verify tombstone markers and produce a signed receipt referencing original job run id and storage object generation numbers. We need to add this to the runbook as `erasure:proof-replay`
Priya R.: I'll produce a small script to collect alternate evidence: storage metadata, object generations, KMS access logs, job traces, and container logs. Example commands: ```bash
gsutil ls -L gs://redwood-embeds/acct-5544/** > /tmp/acct-5544-met.txt
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="gce_instance" AND jsonPayload.jobId="eraser-2026-03-20"' --project=redwood-prod --limit=1000 > /tmp/eraser-trace.json
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName: "Decrypt" AND resource.labels.project_id: "redwood-kms"' --project=redwood-kms --freshness=30d > /tmp/kms-decrypts.json
```
Omar N.: I'll pull KMS logs and also confirm key version used. If we find decrypt activity for that timeframe, it supports deletion happened. If keys weren't used then maybe the job removed metadata only
Anya (Legal): Collect the alternate evidence into an audit bundle. If we can reasonably demonstrate deletion through indirect logs and object generation numbers we can satisfy the DSAR. If not, escalate for retention-exception or a remediation commitment. Also include who approved the RBAC change and why
Sam T.: I've created incident PRV-5012: "missing-app-audit-for-dsar-acct-5544" and a follow-up SEC-2098: "rbac-hardening-erasure-sa". Linking both here. PRV-5012 assigned to Lina, SEC-2098 assigned to Omar
Lina V.: I'll own the audit bundle and the proof-replay runbook entry. ETA EOD.
Priya R.: I'll start assembling the evidence into `gs://redwood-privacy/audit-bundles/PRV-5012/` and include command logs and checksums
AuditBot: incident PRV-5012 created, severity=high, assignees=[Lina V.], links=[SEC-2098]
Anya (Legal): Once bundle is ready, I'll review and advise on whether a retention exception is needed. If we decide on exception, we need documented approvals from Security and Product and a customer communication template
Sam T.: Two immediate mitigations for runbook: - require a pre-deploy check that service accounts retain logging.emit/write permissions for erasure jobs - enable a synthetic audit event emitter (fallback) that writes receipts to an immutable audit bucket even if app logs fail. Filing PRV-5013 to capture runbook updates
Omar N.: Also proposing an automated monitor that alerts if expected structured audit entries are missing for runs in the past 24h. I'll open SEC-2099 to add to monitoring
Lina V.: Copy. Will produce the audit bundle and runbook patch. If we need to communicate to the DSAR requester, legal will draft language.
Sam T.: Thanks team. Keep updates in PRV-5012 thread. I'll notify Support to mark the DSAR as "in progress - evidence gathering" and send a short note to requester letting them know were compiling formal proof. :white_check_mark:
